?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:132534
Court No. - 70

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 28298 of 2024
Applicant :- Sunil Kumar

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Arvind Agrawal
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.

Heard Sri Arvind Agrawal, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Pankaj Kumar, learned Aga
for the State-respondent.
2.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
43 of 2024, under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B IPC and 3/9 U.P. Public Examination Act,
Police Station- Makkhanpur, District- Firozabad, during pendency of the trial in the court below.

3. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that as per allegation, in place of applicant,
co-accused Shashank Kumar appeared in the examination but applicant never instructed co-accused to appear in the examination in his place and on the basis of false allegation, applicant has been made accused in the present matter.
4. He further submitted that however, bail application of co-accused Shashank Kumar, who appeared in the examination, has been dismissed by this Court vide order dated 14.05.2024 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 14752 of 2024 and while rejecting his bail application, this Sunil Kumar vs State Of U.P. on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/27201893/

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Court also observed that the conduct of the applicant and co-accused is highly detrimental for the purpose of examination process but all the alleged offences are triable by Magistrate-I Class and applicant is not having any criminal history.

5. He further submitted that recently the Apex Court in case of Manish Sisodia vs. Directorate of Enforcement arising out of SLP(Crl.) No. 8772 of 2024 decided on 09.08.2024, observed that bail is rule while jail is exception.

entities.text: Manish Sisodia vs. Directorate of Enforcement
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
6. He further submitted that the Apex Court in case of Javed Gulam Nabi Shaikh vs. State of Maharashtra and Another passed in Criminal Appeal No. 2787 of 2024 arising out of SLP (Crl.) No.
3809 of 204, also observed that bail application of an accused cannot withheld for the punitive purpose, therefore, considering the observation made by the Apex Court in both the above noted cases, applicant should be released on bail.

entities.text: Javed Gulam Nabi Shaikh vs. State of Maharashtra and Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 7. Per contra, learned AGA however, opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the argument on facts advanced by learned counsel for the applicant.
8. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

9. However, as per allegation, in place of applicant, co-accused Shashank Kumar appeared in the examination and bail application of co-accused Shashank Kumar has already been dismissed by this Court but it reflects that applicant is not having any criminal history and all the alleged offences are triable by Magistrate-I Class and recently the Apex Court in case of Javed Gulam(supra) on which reliance was placed by learned counsel for the applicant
observed that bail application of an accused should not be withheld for the punitive purpose.

10. Further, recently the Apex Court in case of Mansih Sisodia(supra) on which also reliance was placed by learned counsel for the applicant observed that bail is rule while bail rejection is exception.

11. Therefore, considering the observations made by the Apex Court in both above noted cases and the fact that there can be no parity of the bail rejection order, in my view applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
12. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

13. Let the applicant- Sunil Kumar be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.

sentences.text: (ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
14. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

15. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
